'''Momaw Mowadan''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked in the infirmary of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. Mowadan was on board when the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] was [[Attack on the Kuari Princess|attacked]] by the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]].

==Behind the scenes==
When [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']] was reprinted in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Five]]'', the character was referred to only as "Doctor Mowadan," removing the first name.
